purpose: 和モダンなアプリアイコン案04。16pxで日輪と三本の波線を判別できる不透明な正方形ファビコン候補。
generation_tool: OpenAI built-in GPT Image via image_gen
source_rights: User-authored brief; no external image reference used; original GPT Image generation.
character_usage_reason: 汎用UIアイコンであり、日輪と波のみが用途上の主題。装飾的なGODS／OTOMOは不要。
final_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: production favicon PNG, square 1:1
Create a strict two-ink flat graphic, as if exported from a simple vector drawing program—NOT a rendered scene and NOT an illustration with lighting.
Canvas/background: one single uniform opaque sky-blue color across every background pixel, edge to edge. Absolutely no lighting, no bright center, no dark corners, no radial effect, no gradient, no vignette, no glow, no noise, no texture.
Foreground: exactly four pure-white shapes only: (1) one solid white circle centered in the upper half; (2) exactly three separate, very thick, smooth horizontal wave strokes stacked beneath it. Each stroke has rounded ends and only broad slow curves. All four foreground shapes use a single uniform pure-white fill with no shading.
Composition: centered, balanced, generous outer padding, app-icon safe area; circle separated from the top wave; all three waves separated by large blue gaps. Full-bleed square image, no transparent pixels.
Critical favicon requirement: recognizable at 16×16 px. Favor an unmistakable silhouette, very thick strokes, large gaps, no fine features.
Palette: exactly two flat colors only: sky blue and white.
Do not add anything else: no text, no letters, no border, no rounded frame outline, no sun rays, no foam, no droplets, no clouds, no birds, no ornaments, no watermark, no mockup, no shadows, no bevels, no highlights.

visual_review.opaque_background: PASS: RGB PNG, no alpha channel
visual_review.element_count: PASS: one white circle and three separate white wave lines
visual_review.forbidden_detail: PASS: no text or decorative pictorial elements observed
visual_review.final_crop: PASS: all required shapes remain inside the square crop with generous padding
visual_review.favicon_16px: PASS: inspected a true 16x16 downscale; circle and all three wave lines remain individually recognizable
